integrity.proof: Analytic argument for all stated parameters with finite deterministic corroboration.

scientific_limitations: Normalized univariate Gaussian target; deterministic exact expectation integrator only.
No claim for multidimensional covariance, mixture interactions, stochastic noise or finite floating-point implementation.

The Ricker global-convergence result at constant time step and Coppel interval theorem are acknowledged classical ingredients; historical priority of the complete capped and coupled-mean statement remains subject to independent review.
title: Sharp convergence and amplification frontiers for adaptive exponential Gaussian inference
